description: This file defines a custom view class 'CustomViewPager' that extends Android's ViewPager. It adds functionality to enable or disable touch-based paging gestures, likely to control user interaction with a pager component in the app.

classes.name: CustomViewPager
classes.description: A subclass of ViewPager providing the ability to enable or disable swipe gestures.

methods.name: CustomViewPager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the custom ViewPager with context and attribute set.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Override to control touch event processing based on the enabled flag.

methods.name: onInterceptTouchEvent
methods.description: Override to control intercepting touch events based on the enabled flag.

methods.name: setPagingEnabled
methods.description: Method to enable or disable paging via touch gestures.
